chapter_mission: Ben and Talon confirm the offworld destination and finalize the off-grid transit plan. Luke can only offer limited quiet support without making the case official. They prepare to leave.
chapter_turn: Act turn. Ben and Talon leave for Iresh, knowing the Vigil/Foundation is already moving to recover something Jacen left there.

scene_plan.purpose: Ben and Talon confirm the offworld destination and finalize the off-grid transit plan. Luke can only offer limited quiet support without making the case official.

The Coruscant→Iresh crossing: three days off-grid in hyperspace. The forced partnership becomes real (Talon names the Fall of Coruscant evacuations he survived as a boy); Ben reckons with Iresh as a stop on Jacen's Force odyssey (the Aing-Tii of the Kathol Rift, the Fallanassi, Vergere) and privately decides he will use what Jacen left in him to save lives. Homes the Jacen's-odyssey and Talon's-war texture threads.
